About Agoda
Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more . Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership,enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.
Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel
We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.
We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.
Get to Know Our Team
The Data department , based in Bangkok , oversees all of Agoda’s data-related requirements. Our ultimate goal is to enable and increase the use of data in the company through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, queue systems, BI tools, and data science technology. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the Data team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, engineers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the Data department, but also the reward.
The Opportunity
Please note -The role will be based in Bangkok.
We are looking for ambitious and agile data scientists that would like to seize the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging productive machine learning and big data platforms worldwide, processing some 600B events every day and making some 5B predictions.
As part of the Data Science and Machine Learning (AI/ML) team you will be exposed to real-world challenges such as: dynamic pricing, predicting customer intents in real time, ranking search results to maximize lifetime value, classifying and deep learning content and personalization signals from unstructured data such as images and text, making personalized recommendations, innovating algorithm-supported promotions and products for supply partners, discovering insights from big data, and innovating the user experience. To tackle these challenges, you will have the opportunity to work on one of the world’s largest ML infrastructure employing dozens of GPUs working in parallel, 30K+ CPU cores and 150TB of memory.
In This Role, You’ll Get to

  • Design, code, experiment and implement models and algorithms to maximize customer experience, supply side value, business outcomes, and infrastructure readiness
  • Mine a big data of hundreds of millions of customers and more than 600M daily user generated events, supplier and pricing data, and discover actionable insights to drive improvements and innovation
  • Work with developers and a variety of business owners to deliver daily results with the best quality
  • Research discover and harness new ideas that can make a difference
What You’ll Need To Succeed
  • 4+ years hands-on data science experience
  • Excellent understanding of AI/ML/DL and Statistics, as well as coding proficiency using related open source libraries and frameworks
  • Significant proficiency in SQL and languages like Python, PySpark and/or Scala
  • Can lead, work independently as well as play a key role in a team
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills for working in a multicultural work environment
It’s Great if You Have
  • PhD or MSc in Computer Science / Operations Research / Statistics or other quantitative fields
  • Experience in NLP, image processing and/or recommendation systems
  • Hands on experience in data engineering, working with big data framework like Spark/Hadoop
  • Experience in data science for e-commerce and/or OTA
We welcome both local and international applications for this role. Full visa sponsorship and relocation assistance available for eligible candidates.

A Prudential se preocupa com o seu desenvolvimento oferecendo treinamentos, autonomia na sua carreira e crescimento durante toda sua trajetória. Em paralelo, promovemos o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores com ações internas voltadas para qualidade de vida.

About the project:

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer , you will own and optimize OpenTelemetry pipelines, enabling scalable and efficient observability. You’ll build tools that empower teams, support incident response, and drive best practices. Your work ensures a reliable, secure infrastructure and actionable alerting across the organization.

How your day-to-day work will look like

Design, implement, and maintain observability pipelines across the three main signals—logs, metrics, and traces—ensuring standardized, scalable, and efficient data ingestion. Optimize ingestion strategies to balance cost, performance, and usability.

Build self-service automation and tooling that enables development teams to instrument and leverage observability without requiring manual intervention from the SRE team. Drive adoption of best practices while ensuring teams own their telemetry.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Interact with members from almost all teams across the business to understand their monitoring, alerting, and SLO / SLA requirements and design systems and processes that ensure we meet or exceed these requirements. Influence architectural decisions during initial design stages to ensure resiliency and scale at the outset of software development.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to provision and manage monitoring tools, alerting rules, and our observability configurations across OTEL Pipelines.

Design base-level requirements for new and existing services to ensure that all client infrastructure and code are monitored consistently and accurately at a basic level.

Take full ownership of client infrastructure reliability, ensuring adherence to key availability and security KPIs.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ Years of experience working as an SRE Engineer or in a very similar role, more focused on observability.

5+ Years of experience working with cloud (AWS).

5+ Years of experience working with IaC tools (Terraform) and GitOps CI/CD solutions (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, or similar).

4+ Years of experience working with monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, New Relic, or Datadog (experience managing observability pipelines at scale in high-throughput environments).

4+ Years of experience working in Kubernetes, including its core components, deployment methodologies, and monitoring best practices.

Strong communication skills with team members and stakeholders (technical and nontechnical communication).

Strong scripting abilities (Python, Go, or similar) for automating observability tasks.

Experience integrating incident management platforms (PagerDuty, Jira) with automated alerting workflows.

Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Job description

Adnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para oAeroporto do Galeão (GIG)!


Main responsibilities

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.

Requirements and skills

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E .
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.


Main responsibilities

Diagnosticar e acompanhar o portador de transtorno mental, articular os recursos da rede para oferecer a melhor combinação de estratégias de cuidado, de maneira individualizada, em cada fase do tratamento e apoiar as equipes e profissionais, realizando atividades de educação permanente e utilizando a ferramenta do apoio matricial.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CFD Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at ABS Consulting. This role is critical in advancing our computational fluid dynamics (CFD) capabilities, driving the development of cutting-edge simulations to optimize product performance and efficiency across various applications.
What You Will Do

  • Lead the development and implementation of CFD methodologies to analyze complex fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical reactions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall engineering goals.
  • Design and execute simulation plans, including grid generation, model setup, and validation against experimental data.
  • Utilize advanced post-processing techniques to analyze simulation results, identifying key insights and communicating findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CFD technology, integrating new tools and methodologies into the engineering workflow.
  • Performs advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling for quantitative risk analysis, including Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis, and Helideck Turbulence Analysis
  • Assists qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Suports Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) to ensure compliance with safety standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Implements and maintains ABS Quality System requirements relative to responsibilities after undergoing ABS Quality System training.
  • Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience:
  • Master’s in chemical, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field with a strong emphasis on fluid dynamics and experience on O&G projects.
  • Experience in CFD analysis, with proficiency in industry-standard software such as FLACS, KFX, CFX , ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or COMSOL.
  • Solid understanding of turbulence modeling, heat transfer, and multiphase flow dynamics.
  • Experience in qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis.
  • Experience in Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).
  • Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM) principles.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian regulations (e.g., Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP, NRs) is a plus.
  • Professional or chartered engineering license
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  • Good command of the English language with the ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Expertise in computational fluid dynamics simulation and modeling techniques.
  • Proficiency in software tools for mesh generation, simulation, and post-processing.
  • Understanding of numerical methods and algorithms used in CFD.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.
It Would Be Nice If You Have:
  • Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.
  • Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings.
Reporting Relationships:
The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

Join to apply for the Customer Success Manager (Brazil) role at SecurityScorecard

SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.

Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.” SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

Why join SecurityScorecard’s Customer Success Team?

The SecurityScorecard Customer Success team is empowered by the company to help guide customers to get the most out of our great products and services. We define our Customer Success strategies, priorities and go-to-market techniques. We blaze new trails in cybersecurity thought leadership using our cybersecurity ratings and cybersecurity insights. We are a proactive CSM team that is customer centric, uses a team approach and represents the voice of the customer every day.

About The Role

The Customer Success Manager will play an important role in helping our Enterprise customers transform the way they assess security risk. The SecurityScorecard Customer Success team not only manages relationships and delights customers — they also understand our customers’ organizational goals and unique challenges to help them operationalize our platform and become more secure.

In this role, you'll own and manage customer relationships with customers, ensuring their happiness and communicating the value of our product to drive deeper, more robust engagement. You will apply your understanding of cybersecurity, third-party risk, our products, services, and best practices to proactively provide support and guidance to our customers.

  • Design success for a portfolio of enterprise and strategic customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding/implementation through upsell and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to reach their business objectives and operational goals.

  • Work with CS and Sales VPs to continuously improve the customer journey and develop the tools and templates to ensure the CSM team employs best practices. Support fellow CSMs in solving new challenges across customers.
  • Model world class customer care and be an advocate for the voice of the customer in product and services design and deployment.

  • 3+ years of experience supporting B2B customers in a SaaS organization as a customer success manager, technical account manager or similar customer-facing role.

Get to know us
Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric in a secure business collaboration market. Trusted by more than 2,000,000 users from 175,000 companies globally, we are on a mission to create more prosperity in the world by accelerating high-stakes business decisions. We achieve this by delivering extremely intuitive and robust software products that help people make impactful decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours:
Ideals Virtual Data Room: A web-based cloud platform used by companies in a wide range of industries to ensure secure confidential document sharing for online due diligence, fundraising transactions, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other business goals.
Ideals Board: A cloud platform with web and mobile applications used by board members, CEOs, executives, and corporate secretaries, to streamline governance and improve high-stake decisions in a fast, secure, and compliant way.
The role
Delivering exceptional customer experience is key at Ideals. Our Customer Success team has been crucial in driving a high level of customer satisfaction and securing our Market Leader status on G2 for 5 consecutive years.
We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our Customer Success team in Sao Paulo or Rio, Brazil . This is a post-sales role with full portfolio ownership: you’ll lead renewals, upsells, and account expansion for high-value B2B clients - including some of the most strategic names in our LATAM portfolio.
You’ll work cross-functionally to drive adoption and maximize account potential, with direct influence over revenue targets and client outcomes.
This is a unique opportunity to build an excellent track record in a multinational, mature yet fast-evolving SaaS environment. You will directly enhance customer satisfaction and retention, supporting our scaling in the LATAM region and globally.
What You Will Do

  • Research and study new clients to identify their expected value from the product
  • Conduct kick-off (onboarding) training for new clients
  • Manage a portfolio of 100 accounts - including 30% high-touch - with structured follow-ups, clear prioritization, and proactive engagement across the entire customer journey
  • Engage with clients through their product journey and ensure appropriate experience to increase adoption and retention
  • Execute renewals and expansions proactively, based on account usage, growth potential, and business insights
  • Support clients through email/phone when they have a question or a concern

What You Bring
  • Native-level Portuguese and full professional proficiency in English (C1)
  • At least 5 years of experience as an Account Manager or a CSM in B2B, preferably in SaaS
  • Proven track record managing a book of business of 50+ accounts, with a strong ability to plan, organize and prioritize effectively
  • Experience driving MRR/ARR growth through renewals, upsells, or cross-sells
  • Experience in leading the commercial conversations with the client (e.g., pricing, discounting, upsell)
  • Customer-driven personality with empathetic and emotional intelligence skills
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
Nice to have
  • Spanish language at conversational level or higher
  • Familiarity with data rooms, board portals, or secure collaboration tools
  • Experience in sales

  • Screening call with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (45 mins)
  • Roleplay with the Hiring Manager (1 hour)
  • Competency-based interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (90 mins)
  • Hiring Manager interview (60 mins)
What we offer
We highly value our people, so we will provide you with all the resources and support you need to succeed.
For your work
  • Remote-first model with teams distributed globally
  • Home office set up budget
  • High-end laptop, monitor, and additional individual IT budget

Our culture
Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. For us, these are the principles that every Idealer lives and breathes. We are on the lookout for like-minded individuals who share our values. By doing so, we are able to create a team where talents feel at ease and are able to work to the best of their abilities.

Collaboration and Trust ensure that everyone has access to all the information, proactively shares thoughts, and leverages the teammates’ diverse opinions, experiences, and backgrounds. Both values help us to solve the most challenging problems. Care drives us to create a positive work environment and make everyone feel valued. We also stand for Idealers’ physical, mental, financial, and personal well-being and encourage a healthy lifestyle and active living.
Idealers work in a remote-first model , meaning we collaborate from anywhere – either home, cafe, co-working space, or one of our offices. Despite being located across the globe, we stay connected through the latest tools and technologies, ensuring that everyone on our team feels surrounded by teammates and engaged with our common goals.

Ideals is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people from all walks of life. JOB DESCRIPTION:

Pesquisador(a) de Desenvolvimento Analítico Nível Sênior

Sobre a Abbott

A Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre antecipando mudanças na ciência e tecnologias médicas.

Trabalhando na Abbott

Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena. Você terá acesso a:

  • Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos.
  • Reconhecimento mundial como um ótimo lugar para trabalhar, presente em dezenas de países, e uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela revista Fortune.
  • Reconhecimento como uma das melhores grandes empresas para se trabalhar, incluindo categorias de diversidade, mães que trabalham, executivas e cientistas.

A oportunidade

Esta posição tem local de trabalho no Rio de Janeiro, no negócio de Medicamentos de Marca e Produtos Farmacêuticos. Nosso compromisso é fornecer benefícios de medicamentos de confiança para países em rápido crescimento e desenvolvimento. Nosso portfólio inclui medicamentos de alta qualidade em áreas terapêuticas como gastroenterologia, saúde feminina, cardiometabólico, sistema nervoso central, respiratório, saúde do consumidor e vacina contra a gripe.

Responsabilidades

  • Cumprir normas de boas práticas de laboratório.
  • Elaborar e atualizar especificações técnicas e métodos de análise de matérias-primas e produtos acabados.
  • Avaliar documentos de fornecedores, monitorar recursos analíticos e elaborar relatórios técnicos.
  • Desenvolver e orientar no desenvolvimento de métodos de análise de insumos e produtos formulados.
  • Validar e orientar na validação de métodos de análise de insumos e produtos.
  • Analisar e orientar atividades de análise de insumos, amostras de pré-formulações, lotes piloto, produtos acabados e produtos em estabilidade.
  • Dar suporte técnico ao controle de qualidade, interno e externo, na transferência de novos métodos analíticos.
  • Realizar pesquisas bibliográficas e ser responsável pela etapa analítica dos projetos designados.
  • Realizar estudos e perfis de degradação de matéria-prima e do produto acabado.
  • Desenvolver e avaliar métodos discriminativos de perfis de dissolução comparativos.
  • Desenvolver e validar métodos de validação de limpeza.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica para submissão de novos registros, em parceria com os departamentos Regulatório e Desenvolvimento Galênico, atendendo à legislação vigente.
  • Avaliar criticamente os resultados analíticos obtidos.
  • Garantir a padronização das atividades através da elaboração e revisão dos Procedimentos Operacionais (OPs).
  • Contribuir para que a área Analítica esteja sempre de acordo com as normas de GMP e EHS.
  • Conhecer os riscos potenciais nas novas atividades antes do início do trabalho.
  • Participar de estudos de viabilidade de projetos e avaliação técnica-regulatória de documentos de registro de novos medicamentos.
  • Ter experiência com cromatografia líquida e gasosa, espectrofotometria UV/VIS e IR.
  • Ter experiência com desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos, estudos de estabilidade e de degradação forçada.
  • Possuir conhecimentos sólidos em legislações de analítica.
  • Experiência com validação de limpeza e desenvolvimento de métodos de perfil de dissolução.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Formação universitária em Farmácia, Química ou Engenharia Química.
  • Sólida experiência na função.

Candidate-se agora

Siga suas aspirações de carreira na Abbott, uma empresa que pode ajudar você a construir seu futuro e viver da melhor maneira possível. A Abbott oferece oportunidades iguais e é comprometida com a diversidade de colaboradores.

Conecte-se conosco em e acompanhe-nos pelo Facebook/Abbott Brasil , LinkedIn e Twitter @AbbottNews .

Analista de Desempenho e Estratégia Pleno | Gestão de Portfólio e Parque de Tecnologia

Job Description
Nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Job Description
Nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.
Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.
Somos a área de Portfólio da Governança de Tecnologia. Nosso time tem como objetivo traduzir, priorizar e gerir as iniciativas de investimento através de business cases, projetos e produtos, garantindo assim um alinhamento com os objetivos financeiros da empresa, estratégia corporativa, criticidade do negócio e tendências de tecnologia do mercado. Construindo um portfólio de investimento e parque de ativos eficiente por meio de análises de valor, viabilizando uma tomada de decisão ágil, repactuando os entregáveis e garantindo a otimização de caixa da empresa e alinhamento estratégico.
Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.
Responsibilities and assignments
Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar na construção da carteira de investimento de tecnologia, estruturando os processos de consolidação, priorização e orçamentação através da análise de cenários e classificação de iniciativas, interface com os executivos de Tecnologia;
  • Desenvolver estudos de viabilidade de projetos de tecnologia e cenários financeiros que traduzam ideias e iniciativas transformacionais em análises estruturadas com benefícios intangíveis e riscos envolvidos para apoiar a tomada de decisão;
  • Liderar e facilitar os processos internos e externos como ponto focal da gestão de portfólio de investimentos e parque de ativos, apoiando na construção e acompanhamento mudanças, desvios de escopo, orçamento e/ou cronograma nos projetos e programas da carteira de investimentos, utilizando metodologia ágeis, processos e ferramentas;
  • Liderar e facilitar os processos internos e externos como ponto focal da gestão de resultado, apoiando no cumprimento das metas do caixa/ano definidas para o portfólio de investimentos de Tecnologia, conduzindo BGs (melhor cenário) periódicos junto aos gestores responsáveis pelos projetos e apoiando a preparação e comunicação do Ciclo Anual de Investimento e Comitês de Investimento;
  • Construir bases de dados estruturados, confiáveis e atuais de forma clara, didática e abrangente para embasar a tomada de decisão (business cases, painéis de dados, análise de cenários e riscos, base de ativos, entre outros);
  • Construir apresentações, análises e dashboards para report e decisão em diversos níveis estratégicos, desde o tático até os executivos.
Requirements And Qualifications
Do que você precisa:
  • Conhecimento em Excel e Power Point avançados;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em finanças corporativas e viabilidade de projetos;
  • Capacidade de análise de dados;
  • Capacidade de relacionar-se de maneira colaborativa, articulada, construtiva e em equipe.
Conhecimentos que te destacam:
  • Conhecimento em Media Tech;
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência com ERP da Oracle.
Additional information

Job description

Somos a Árvore, a plataforma gamificada de aprendizagem que semeia o prazer em aprender.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Líder de Negócios Governamentais , com experiência robusta em vendas consultivas e articulação estratégica no setor público, especialmente junto a Secretarias de Educação.

Esta é uma posição sênior e estratégica , com protagonismo na expansão da atuação da Árvore junto a Redes estaduais e municipais de capitais e grandes cidades, além da construção da vertical de vendas governamentais da empresa. Buscamos alguém com visão sistêmica, habilidade de articulação com lideranças públicas e forte compromisso com a transformação da educação em larga escala.

Você se reportará diretamente à Head de Setor Público e atuará em constante interlocução com o CEO e outras lideranças executivas.


Main responsibilities
  • Definir e executar a estratégia de crescimento no setor público;
  • Construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com redes públicas (Secretarias Estaduais e Municipais de Educação);
  • Conduzir vendas consultivas complexas (B2G), com foco em soluções personalizadas;
  • Atuar com segurança em processos de contratação pública, inclusive com base na nova Lei de Licitações (14.133/21);
  • Representar a empresa em reuniões estratégicas, visitas técnicas e eventos;
  • Refatorar e escalar processos comerciais voltados ao setor público;
  • Integrar-se a times de produto, CS e conteúdo para garantir entregas alinhadas à realidade das redes.

Requirements and skills
  • Experiência relevante em vendas ou parcerias no setor público (educação/edtechs são grandes diferenciais);
  • Histórico de relacionamento com Secretarias de Educação e gestores públicos;
  • Conhecimento prático de compras públicas, licitações e contratos administrativos;
  • Habilidades analíticas e consultivas, com forte capacidade de articulação institucional;
  • Comunicação fluente e influência em ambientes estratégicos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • CNH ativa.

Additional information

Seria bom se você também tivesse:

  • Formação em Administração, Gestão Pública, Direito, Educação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência em edtechs, consultorias ou organizações com impacto em políticas públicas;
  • Conhecimento em SPIN Selling, CRM e vendas B2G;
  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança e gestão de processos comerciais.

O que você vai encontrar aqui:

  • Salário compatível com mercado;

title: Senior Full-Stack Web Software Engineer (Remote)
description:
Unilingo connects a single video to every audience, in every language, on every major platform — with no extra work. This is not some ‘one-click’ marketing fluff. With Unilingo, one upload is all it takes. We pioneered multi-language content for YouTube, putting MrBeast and other top creators into 10+ languages. Since then, we've given creators 100 billion views, $50 million in AdSense revenue, and global recognition. With 48,000+ global submissions in the pipeline, we're only getting started. We’re building the command center for digital content — a syndication network that publishes from a single upload to any platform, in any format, in any language.
What you build here will be seen in every country on Earth.
Please email your resume to:

The Role
We’re a growing team of self-motivated engineers. We put in long hours not because we have to but because we care about the impact we’re generating. We hope to do more in a week than most other teams do in a month.
We are looking for a full-stack engineer who’s excited to experience the adventure of being in an early stage startup. We hope for your time here to be the most rewarding in your career. You’ll be given a lot of responsibility and the freedom to solve problems.
Responsibilities
Own the problem and work with the engineers and designer to generate a solution
Build, test, and ship features that solves user problems
Look at data and talk to users to get feedback about the feature
Triage and fix bugs
Generate proposals (through meetings, docs, and Figma) to help align team on your solution if it’s a multi-person effort
Review PRs to ensure that you’re not siloed in your own feature and that standards are upheld
Requirements
5+ years of experience with Node, React, and Typescript
You’re not afraid to touch all parts of code when needed — from mouse click to DB. If you specialize in back-end, you should at least be able to disable a button on the front-end. If you’re front-end, you should at least be able to cast a return type of an endpoint field from a string to an int
Deploy your own code. We don’t have an ops team here, so you get to own deployment as well
Excellent written skills (in English)
B2 or above spoken English proficiency
Bonus
Previous startup experience — having started your own or joined one before
Python and some experience with implementing or deploying ML models
Speaks a language other than English (and code)
Cloud functions, NoSQL DB
Why Work With Us
You’ll hopefully experience the highest growth rate of your career here. You’ll be given freedom to execute. You and the rest of the team will likely make mistakes, but that’s okay because it’s a signal that we’re going to the edge of our capabilities - which means growth. We believe that this is what a startup is all about.
You will be working closely with Jon, our CTO, and Farbod, our CEO. Jon is an ex-Meta engineer and a top creator himself in his past life with 20M+ views across YouTube and TikTok. Farbod is a serial entrepreneur with one exit and is obsessed about distributing the highest quality content for their users. He’s spent months living with creators (literally) to understand their workflows, pain points, and what they need next.
Values
Mission over team over self : We value distributing content to our customers globally, working hard, and having fun with our team — without ego. Everyone at the company contributes to the final product.
We constantly question the status quo : We don’t copy what’s been done before. We ask, “What would this look like if we started from scratch?” and we’re not afraid to break norms to do things better.
Work hard and smart : We put in long hours, but only on the highest-value tasks. Our goal is to grow the company — and for everyone here to grow with it.
We move at the speed of light to delight our users : Our ideal sprint is three to four days. Our ideal shipping cadence is daily.
Artifacts are greater than talking : We communicate through action. That means documents, Figma files, Slack updates, commits, PRs — whatever it takes to keep work flowing asynchronously.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Floorplan-to-3D Automation)
description:
About Formify
Formify
is building the future of digital manufacturing for interior spaces --- from online 3D configuration to ready-to-machine outputs for kitchens, closets, and bathrooms. As part of our roadmap, we're developing AI tools that convert floorplans into 3D layouts to accelerate design, quoting, and production workflows.
Your Role
We're seeking an AI/ML Engineer to lead the development of a system that can
analyze floorplan images (PDFs, DWGs, etc.) and convert them into 3D geometry
--- walls, doors, windows, and more --- ready for our CPQ engine. You'll develop core AI capabilities and work closely with our design automation and backend teams to bring intelligent layout recognition to life.
What You'll Do
Design and train deep learning models to extract spatial and semantic information from 2D floorplans (images or vector files).
Develop pipelines to convert detected geometry into structured 3D models (e.g., wall objects, door/window placement).
Work with vector data (DXF/DWG), PDFs, or raster images to detect key architectural features.
Collaborate with CAD and backend engineers to translate AI output into parametric geometry.
Optimize models for speed, accuracy, and usability in real-world production environments.
Create optimal cabinetry layouts and suggestions from data provided from designers.
Experience Levels
Mid-Level (3-6 years experience)
Strong experience with
deep learning frameworks
(PyTorch, TensorFlow) and
vision models
(YOLO, UNet, Detectron, etc.)
Experience in
computer vision
or
document/image parsing
Understanding of
geometry-based learning
and spatial context
Ability to translate model output into geometric representations
Senior Level (6+ years experience)
Advanced expertise in
geometry-based learning ,
OCR with spatial context , and complex vision systems
Proven ability to lead ML projects from conception to production
Experience with CAD/BIM environments, Rhino/Grasshopper, or geometry processing libraries (e.g., trimesh, Open3D)
Track record of deploying ML models in real-world manufacturing or design environments
Project leadership and team mentoring experience
Bonus Experience
Experience with CAD/BIM environments, Rhino/Grasshopper, or geometry processing libraries
Knowledge of architectural drawing standards and conventions
Experience in manufacturing or design automation industries
Why You'll Love This
You'll work at the bleeding edge of vision + design automation.
Your work will drastically reduce the time from inspiration to production in the interiors industry.
Join a cross-functional team where AI connects directly to real-world manufacturing.
Competitive compensation with opportunity to pioneer AI applications in manufacturing.

title: Sr. SAP Fieldglass Developer
description:
Title: Sr. SAP Fieldglass Developer
Location: Remote, candidates based out of Brazil
Duration: 6 month CLT contract with potential to extend
Pay Range: $20-30k BRL per month
Must Haves:
5+ years of experience in SAP development, with at least 4 years in SAP Fieldglass (SOW, CW, integrations).
Proven experience in Fieldglass-SAP S/4HANA integration, including CPI and API-based approaches.
Strong understanding of Fieldglass data models, configuration, and extensibility.
Experience with facility access systems integration is a strong plus.
Familiarity with SAP BTP, SAP Business Network, and clean core principles.
Ability to conduct technical assessments, identify gaps, and propose remediation strategies.
English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus.
Proven experience implementing Fieldglass integrations
Strong understanding of SAP best practices, architecture principles, and integration strategies.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Experience in Agile methodology usage would be differential.
SAP certifications would be considered differential.
Day to Day:
A Senior SAP Fieldglass Developer is required to lead the technical assessment, enhancement, and implementation of strategic initiatives across the SAP Fieldglass platform. This role focuses on optimizing contingent workforce management, improving integration reliability, and enabling advanced capabilities such as assignment management and facility access integration. The developer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, compliant, and clean core-aligned solutions.
Assess and implement Fieldglass Assignment Management to streamline the integration between maintenance work orders and contingent labor.
Ensure accurate data flow and process alignment between Fieldglass and SAP S/4HANA.
Stabilize and enhance integrations between Fieldglass and S/4HANA for SOWs, timesheets, and fee submissions.
Troubleshoot and resolve interface issues, ensuring data consistency and performance.
Design and implement integration between Fieldglass and global facility access systems (e.g., Genetec, Alert Enterprise).
Enable validation of contractor time-on-site against timesheet data for compliance and cost control.
Improve usability and performance of Fieldglass through configuration enhancements and process automation.
Support training and documentation efforts to ensure adoption of optimized workflows.
Support the phased rollout of Fieldglass SOW functionality across Brazil and other South American regions.
Ensure localization, compliance, and alignment with global standards.
Lead technical efforts in expanding Fieldglass CW capabilities across regions (e.g., NAM, SAM, APAC).
Ensure scalable architecture and integration with SAP and third-party systems.
Ensure adherence to SAP Clean Core principles, minimizing custom code and promoting extensibility through SAP BTP and side-by-side extensions.
Advocate for standardized processes and modular architecture to maintain system integrity and simplify upgrades.
Design solutions that leverage SAP-recommended extensibility options such as In-App Extensibility, Key User Tools, and SAP BTP services.
Evaluate and refactor legacy customizations to align with clean core strategies.
Promote decoupled integration using APIs and event-driven architectures to reduce system dependencies.
Collaborate with development teams to ensure custom developments are compliant with SAP’s clean core guidelines.
Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.
Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Sales Director, LATAM
description:
Wenham Carter is proud to be supporting a European software innovator that’s transforming how energy companies across the globe manage their most critical infrastructure.
Our client is a specialist provider of enterprise-grade software built specifically for the electric utility sector. Headquartered in Germany and operating internationally, their suite of products spans Asset Performance Management (APM), Protection & IED, Network Model Management, and Outage Management Systems - empowering utilities to operate with greater insight, safety, and efficiency.
With many of the world’s most advanced grid operators already relying on their technology, the business is now scaling its presence in Latin America. As such, we’re hiring a
Sales Director, LATAM – Energy Markets , to take ownership of the company’s commercial success across the region.
The Opportunity
This is a senior-level, high-impact role for a commercially driven leader with deep roots in the LATAM energy sector. You will spearhead all sales efforts across key territories, particularly
Brazil, Chile, and Colombia
- working directly with utilities, system operators, and regulatory stakeholders to bring best-in-class solutions to mission-critical environments.
You'll be responsible for shaping the regional go-to-market strategy, managing end-to-end enterprise sales cycles, and building high-value, long-term relationships with commercial and technical decision-makers.
What You’ll Do
Drive new business
across LATAM, identifying and converting opportunities within utilities, grid operators, ISOs, and energy companies
Lead strategic enterprise sales cycles , owning deals from initial contact through to close
Develop and execute regional strategy , working closely with the global sales and marketing leadership
Engage deeply with client stakeholders , including executive and operational teams, to foster trust and partnership
Represent the business
at major industry conferences, roundtables, and sector events across Latin America
Partner cross-functionally
with global product, pre-sales, and technical teams to ensure alignment and success
Your Background
We’re looking for a seasoned commercial operator with a strong command of LATAM’s energy markets and a deep understanding of how complex software solutions are sold in industrial environments.
The ideal candidate will bring:
7+ years of enterprise software sales experience (APM, EAM, OT or similar solutions)
A proven track record in the
LATAM utility and energy landscape , especially in
Brazil, Chile, and Colombia
Strong relationships with
grid operators, utilities, and energy stakeholders
in the region
Experience managing
complex, multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales
Fluent Spanish and English
required;
Portuguese
highly advantageous
Gravitas, consultative sales ability, and the resilience to work across both public and private energy institutions
Willingness to travel extensively across Latin America as needed
Why Now?
This is not just another sales role. It’s an opportunity to lead regional expansion for a fast-growing software vendor that’s doubling in size and already trusted by some of the most sophisticated electric utilities worldwide.
You’ll be joining at a time of significant growth, with the autonomy to shape market strategy, influence product direction, and drive measurable impact in an industry undergoing massive digital transformation.
If you're a commercial leader with a passion for the energy sector and a desire to build something meaningful in LATAM, let’s talk.

Remote, Brazil

Jira ; verify fixes and prevent regressions.

Solid grounding in functional, regression, and integration testing methodologies.

Hands-on with Selenium, Cypress, Postman/Newman, or equivalent frameworks.

Confident validating request/response payloads, headers, auth flows, and error handling.

Comfortable creating clear, actionable Jira tickets that engineers love (and fear).

Understand how QA fits into DevOps; you wire tests into CI and keep the build clean.

Bash/Python/TypeScript chops for crafting helpers, stubs, or data generators.
Bonus Points:
Experience using LLMs or AI tools to auto-generate test cases, data, or scripts.

Competitive salary + stock options.

title: Médico Neurologista
description:
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEUROLOGISTA/RESIDENTE NA TELADOC HEALTH"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos
Neurologista,
que esteja cursando Residência, ou Especialização, ou que já tenha concluído a formação. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
*
A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!
O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo em duas modalidades: Clínico Generalista, de acordo com a dinâmica de solicitações e consultas de especialidade em Neurologia, ambos de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DE ATIVIDADES
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Neurologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios neurológicos.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Neurologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais neurológicos através de videochamadas.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças neurológicas.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Neurologia.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
FORMAÇÃO ACADEMICA (será solicitado comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM NEUROLOGIA CONCLUIDAS, OU EM ANDAMENTO
CERTIFICAÇÕES (será solicitada comprovação durante o processo seletivo):
Formação Acadêmica (será submetido a comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PSIQUIATRIA, COMPLETO, OU EM ANDAMENTO
Certificações (serão solicitadas no processo seletivo, como carater eliminatório):
Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Neurologia, modelo oficial (Certidão de RQE/Certificado de Registro de Especialidade, pelo CRM responsável);
Matrícula do último semestre, em Instituição de Ensino aprovada, em Especialização, Residência, ou Pós-Graduação;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).
CONTRATO: PJ - (necessário ter CNPJ)
HORÁRIO: A COMBINAR
REMUNERAÇÃO: SERÁ ALINHADA NO PROCESSO SELETIVO

description:

RapidCanvas is the trusted partner for transforming your business with AI. Our unique approach delivers measurable business outcomes 10X faster at 80% lower cost, helping global leaders in manufacturing, retail and consumer goods, financial services, and infrastructure turn what was once impossible into practical, everyday reality.

AI Success & Solutions
to lead end-to-end delivery of bespoke AI projects—from initial solution design through full customer success ownership. This role merges the depth of a Solutions Architect with the accountability of a Customer Success leader. You will work across pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring our clients see real business value from our AI capabilities. The hiring seniority level will depend on the candidate’s depth of experience across customer-facing solution delivery, ability to drive measurable business impact, and demonstrated ownership in ambiguous or fast-paced environments.

Define clear problem statements, document current state processes, and align on success criteria and KPIs.
Design solution architecture and data flow diagrams tailored to each use case.
Assess data feasibility and AI-fit for the proposed use case.
Set up technical and collaboration workspaces (Slack, Drive, JIRA, etc.) with naming and access discipline.
Post-Sale: Execution & Success

Manage the execution and implementation of the solution, ensuring clarity of scope, timeline, and handoffs.
Lead all internal and customer-facing check-ins, with clear agendas, follow-ups, and next-step ownership.
Facilitate UAT and deployment, ensuring measurable outcomes are validated.
Track and report on success metrics across 30/60/90-day milestones and ensure platform adoption.
Operational Excellence
Maintain rigorous documentation: dataset inventories, architectural diagrams, solution design docs, etc.
Ensure consistent file naming, visual branding, and version control across all customer-facing material.
Keep Slack, HubSpot, JIRA, and Confluence spaces current and synchronized.
Proactively escalate blockers, risks, or unclear ownership to leadership with proposed resolutions.
Strategic Growth
Identify expansion opportunities based on solution usage and customer success metrics.
Collaborate with Product to feed back client needs and usage patterns into roadmap priorities.
Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the client, helping them envision and prioritize future AI investments.
Qualifications
At least six (6) years in a hybrid technical+customer-facing role (Solutions Architect, Customer Success, Engagement Manager, etc.).
Strong understanding of applied Data Science, ML, GenAI (e.g., LLM Prompting, RAG).
Demonstrated success delivering AI or data-driven solutions in a consulting or startup setting.
Excellent storytelling and business value articulation skills for both technical and executive audiences.
Detail-oriented with exceptional project management and follow-through.
Global client experience is strongly preferred.
Prior experience in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with high expectations for ownership and delivery.
Professional fluency in English is required.
Why Join Us
Drive measurable impact for Fortune 500 customers across the globe, helping them turn AI vision into operational value. Be part of a category-defining AI company, pioneering a hybrid model that bridges agents and experts. Own strategic accounts end-to-end and shape what modern AI success looks like. Work with a cross-functional, high-performance team that values execution, clarity, and outcomes. Globally competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your local market. Recognized as a Top 5 Data Science and Machine Learning platform on G2 for customer satisfaction.

Globally competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your local market.

British American Tobacco Brazil has an exciting opportunity for an IT Service Level Manager in Rio de Janeiro
The Service Level Manager (SLM) is responsible for ensuring that all IT services meet the agreed-upon service levels and performance standards. This role involves managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring service performance, and working closely with both internal teams and external vendors to ensure high-quality service delivery. The SLM will play a crucial role in aligning IT services with business objectives and customer expectations.
The position requires strong alignment with ITIL best practices, COBIT governance principles, and industry performance benchmarks. The SLM is also a key agent in driving continuous improvement, digital transformation, and the innovation of user-centric services.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Develop, negotiate, and manage SLAs with internal and external stakeholders and monitor and report on service performance against SLAs.
Conduct regular reviews of SLAs to ensure they remain relevant and aligned with business needs.
Maintain a centralized and accessible Service Catalogue and being responsible for ITSM governance, for example, incident, change, problem and transition management.
Use data-driven insights to predict and prevent potential service disruptions and analyze service performance and structured root cause analysis data to identify trends and areas for improvement.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA
Nossa tecnologia dita o ritmo do mercado. Afinal, 25% do PIB brasileiro passa pelos softwares presentes em mais de 40 mil empresas clientes da TOTVS.
Para que isso aconteça precisamos ser ágeis, pois as coisas aqui acontecem em uma velocidade acima da média. No nosso dia-dia, aprendemos muito e muito rápido, em um ambiente leve, divertido e desafiador.

#ouseetransforme e #sejaTOTVER
Missão do cargo:
Acreditamos que o SUCESSO do cliente é o nosso SUCESSO! E para isso, estamos à procura de pessoas inquietas, fanáticas por resultados e amantes de tecnologia. Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, trabalho em equipe e gosta de fazer acontecer esta vaga será sua! Venha trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza gente boa que é boa gente. Venha ser um TOTVER!Atue com as ferramentas e tecnologias mais modernas existente no mercado, desenvolvemos framework para aplicações cloud native, containerizadas, distribuídas, resilientes, escaláveis, e muito mais!
O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:
Criar códigos que atendam aos nossos padrões internos de estilo, capacidade de manutenção e práticas recomendadas para um ambiente de alta escala. Manter e defender esses padrões por meio de code review;
Desenvolver funcionalidades e melhorias para nossos produtos, com segurança, teste automatizado, documentação e desempenho;

Resolver problemas técnicos de complexidade moderada;
Colaborar com o gerenciamento do produto e outras partes interessadas (Frontend, UX etc.) a fim de manter um ambiente iterativo e acelerado;
Reconhecer impedimentos à nossa eficiência como equipe ("dívida técnica"), propondo e implementando soluções;
Entregar com segurança melhorias com orientação mínima de outros membros da equipe. Colaborar com a equipe em projetos maiores;
Fornecer orientação para engenheiros iniciantes e intermediários de sua equipe para ajudá-los a crescer em suas responsabilidades técnicas.
O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:
Área de formação acadêmica: Relacionada a área de desenvolvimento de software.
Conhecimentos técnicos: Experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
Experiência em C#;
Experiência com RabbitMQ;
Conhecimento em Entity Framework;
Conhecimento em Angular;
Desejável conhecimentos em CQRS e Docker;
Experiência com problemas de desempenho e otimização, particularmente em larga escala, e uma capacidade demonstrada para diagnosticar e prevenir esses problemas;

Mentalidade positiva e orientada para a solução;
Auto motivado, autodidata e auto gerenciado, com fortes habilidades organizacionais;
Desejo de trabalhar em colaboração com outras partes da organização.
INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.
A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.
E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.
Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.
Dito isso, oferecemos:

title: Head of Engineering
description:
CTO/Head of Engineering (Remote)
Are you someone who wants to empower and inspire others? Do you find yourself looking for opportunities for continuous learning and improvement? Are you driven by the satisfaction of completing tasks and achieving goals?
Are you seeking a mission-driven culture that fosters your professional growth? If so, we would love to connect with you!
Who We Are:
We are a remote team that improves online medical education and teaches healthcare professionals domestically and abroad how to save lives. We also take the same advanced life-saving training we developed for medical professionals and give it to underserved populations all around the world at no cost. We work in conjunction with the Disque Foundation to fulfill its mission of advancing healthcare education to the underserved through advanced technology
.
Check out our
website
:
Mission
is to provide free advanced healthcare education to underserved populations in the US and around the world.
Our Goal
is to empower 10 million people by 2025.
Our Values:
Dedication to “CANI” culture:
Constant and Never-Ending Improvement mentality.
Positive Focus/Resourceful/Gritty/Perseverance:
A self-starter who isn’t held back by a lack of direction or detailed instruction.
Impeccable Ball Handling Skills:
Responsibility, Accountability, Ownership.
Unwavering Integrity:
We Always do the Right Thing.
Who we’re looking for:
We seek an executive-level technology leader who is
visionary, strategic, and passionate about innovation
- without needing to be hands-on in coding. As a
CTO/Head of Engineering
, you will guide our tech and product strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and fostering a culture of growth and servant leadership. This is a
hybrid role
combining strategic leadership with hands-on involvement. Approximately 25–30% of the time will be dedicated to implementation and debugging, while the remaining focus will be on system architecture, technical direction, and guiding internal teams.
Work directly with external vendors and partners to align on expectations and drive outcomes—this role does not involve formal vendor management but requires effective collaboration to ensure delivery meets our standards.
Why this role is unique:
We are
transitioning from in-house backend development to a third-party tech provider
to enhance scalability, security, and performance while reducing bugs and maintenance overhead. This is a
strategic shift
that allows us to focus on front-end improvements, marketing experiments, and product innovation. We need a leader excited about this transformation - someone who can refine product strategy, guide teams, and drive innovation rather than push for in-house backend development.
As a CTO/Head of Engineering, you will be responsible for:
Technology & Product Strategy
– Define and execute a long-term technology roadmap aligned with business goals and innovation.
Leadership & Growth
– Inspire, mentor, and empower teams to drive effective execution.
Product Ownership & Execution
– Oversee product evolution, ensuring front-end and API development supports user experience, marketing agility, and growth initiatives.
Security & Scalability
– Ensure site security, performance, and scalability by working with our third-party technology partner while keeping internal processes efficient.
Technical Escalation & Support
– Provide backup for critical issues and guide troubleshooting, ensuring smooth collaboration with third-party providers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
– Collaborate with marketing, sales, and operations to leverage technology for business impact.
Vendor & Partner Management
– Manage relationships with external tech providers to maximize efficiency, reliability, and innovation.
You’ll thrive in this role if you are:
A visionary and servant leader who inspires teams and drives strategy.
Product-driven with business acumen, focusing on strategic impact rather than just technical execution.
Excited about transitioning to a third-party provider, focusing on innovation, scalability, and growth.
Technical but not hands-on daily, guiding decisions without coding every day.
Adaptable, proactive, and resourceful in navigating complex challenges.
A tech enthusiast passionate about AI and emerging technologies.
A strong communicator who can explain complex concepts to non-experts.
Remote-ready and thrive in a flexible, independent work environment.
Must-Have Experience
Leadership experience in a technology or product-focused executive role
Experience with Client side web development (HTML/CSS/JS/Smarty/Smarty Twig)
Deep understanding of front-end and API-driven development (modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, AngularJS), CSS frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap, Foundation, UI Kit), component-based architecture, GraphQL)
Understanding of AWS, CDN, MariaDB, Apache HTTPd web servers, Linux, Cloud computing, CI/CD, cybersecurity
Experience working with Platform as a Service (PaaS) and API-driven environments
Security and scalability expertise in a digital product environment
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage external technology vendors
Experience collaborating with external vendors to drive outcomes without direct management responsibility.
Nice to Have (or willingness to learn)
Cloudflare (maintenance, security, performance optimization)
WordPress, PHP, MySQL
GTM, on-site data tracking, SEO
Experience with automation tools, AI-driven tech, and experimentation platforms (e.g., VWO)
UX/UI familiarity (Figma, Adobe XD)
What This Role is NOT
A hands-on backend developer role.
A position for someone looking to rebuild everything in-house.
A rigid environment - our culture values adaptability, collaboration, and strategic thinking.
Additional Information:
This role is full-time, requiring 35-40 hours per week.
It is a fully remote contract position, with Independent Contractors responsible for their taxes and benefits.
Each applicant is required to successfully complete a paid Trial Period before transitioning to this role.
If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications but believe you will be a great fit, you should still seriously consider applying.
Ready to apply?
If you share our values and enthusiasm for empowering the world, please send a resume and a short cover letter with a brief description of where you see yourself adding value to the team to
.
Please address your cover letter to Helen.

Further, we strongly encourage individuals from traditionally underrepresented identities to apply, including identities not explicitly named above. If there are any considerations or qualifications not acknowledged in our job description that you feel are important and relevant to this position, we encourage you to bring them to light in your application.

title: Software Engineer Specialist
description:

Design and develop distributed SDS solutions
Lead and mentor junior engineers in the team

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering or related field, or proven equivalent professional experience. Experience must be in software development and/or distributed software maintenance
Experience as a software engineer
Experience working on Ceph based solutions
Understanding of various storage offerings; block, object, filesystem
Familiarity with OpenStack, Incus or LXD

Experience in any two of these programing languages: C/C++, Python, Golang, Rust
Good written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English languages

Upstream patches in Ceph, Linux, OpenStack, Incus or LXD
Experience in building storage solutions for end users

- Conhecimento profundo do mercado e produtos odontológicos.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.

· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;

o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.

o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história.
